test.name: Detect a stub record with no facts or relatives (edge case)
test.description: User asks to check Patrick in a just-created project where Patrick (I1) is a bare stub -- name only, no facts, no relationships (the empty-project-just-created scenario). The tool returns missingFactsAndRelatives. This is the 'limited data' edge case the skill's Step 3 expects. The skill should report cleanly with Implausible severity and add the documented hint: 'the person has limited data -- most checks need dates and relatives to fire.' Tests the edge-case handling for under-populated records.

input.delegation:
Check Patrick for warnings.

personId: I1

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should report the missingFactsAndRelatives warning as Implausible (the tool emits severity: 'implausible')

Should include the prescribed wording from the agent body Step 3's special case for this tag -- the response must convey both: (a) 'this person has limited data, so most warning checks need dates and relatives to fire' AND (b) 'adding more research may surface additional issues currently hidden.' Minor paraphrasing of the exact words is acceptable, but BOTH ideas (limited data prevents most checks from firing + further research may surface hidden issues) must appear. A response that only says 'limited data' without the 'further research may surface hidden issues' second half is incomplete; a response that omits both is wrong.
Should NOT escalate this to a Contradiction-level data error -- empty stubs are a known stage of research (just-created persons), not impossibilities
Should NOT suggest fabricating facts to make the record fuller; that would corrupt the data. The right action is to keep researching or accept that this person's profile is intentionally minimal.
